description: Create a free access link for releases of one of the person's artist projects and return it. Bitsound sends no email: the person passes the link on themselves. Whoever opens it first and signs in or creates an account gets the releases in their collection like a purchase at 0 EUR (all download formats, no money, no fee); after that the link is used up. Either chosen releases (published or scheduled) or allMusic for every release published right now. Optional short note only the artist sees, e.g. who the link is for. Limits: per artist and day, and a maximum of open links. The link is only created after the person confirms it in the browser (you get a confirmUrl to give them), afterwards studio_request_status returns it. The link is private: never put it into public texts.

note.description: Short note only the artist sees, e.g. "for Stefan"

releases.description: Releases to give (IDs or URLs), leave out with allMusic

name: studio_free_access_create
title: Create a free access link
